fact: The Direction Generale des Douanes says SYDONIA World has been the central platform dematerialising customs procedures, in operation since 2018.

The Direction Generale des Douanes says a UNCTAD expert's functional and technical audit of SYDONIA World defined the evolutions needed to strengthen its performance, interoperability and security, with the aim of evolving it into a more integrated platform.

La Gazette des Comores reports that the customs information system SYDONIA was interconnected with the tax system SIGIT in a launch on 30 December 2023, with customs operator data cross-checked against tax records.
AFD states its EUR 10m PAGF-SI project, from 7 December 2023, updates the Comoros finance administration applications including SYDONIA to improve their interfacing.
